title: Second-Brain Note Graph Growth
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=note:link
| timechart span=1w dc(note) as notes, count as links
| eval link_density=round(links/notes,2)
description: Trends how your personal knowledge base grows in notes and the links between them over time.
value: Link density, not note count, is what makes a second brain useful; trending it shows whether ideas are connecting.
implementation: Ingest note-graph exports into `index=personal`; trend notes, links, and density weekly.
visualization: Line chart of notes and links over time.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how your personal notes and the links between them grow, building a useful second brain.
